label: Certify an identity ancestor by pair checks along a mediated esse path
meaning: An actual recipient either is an identity bearer or has a finite path from one under the ancestry premise. Excluding actual supply at identity makes the eligibility restriction sound. At that same identity bearer the eligibility rule leaves zero candidate donors, so the checked finite pair criterion applies to the actual path. The case split uses excluded middle. In the alternate hidden-giver models the baseline bearer's represented identity persists even as it receives esse. That assignment pinpoints the disputed exclusion. An interpretation allowing external production of a bearer with the represented identity must supply some other warrant for underivedness.

strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The proof applies excluded middle (not just double-negation elimination) to `p.esseOf x = p.essenceOf x` (in finiteIdentityQueries), the esse–essence identity of an arbitrary actual bearer, which is not given as a GOD_4 candidate. LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
